name: app-dark-games-dashboard-with-lime-outline-pills-and-torn-ticket-card
title: Navy games dashboard with a notched top nav, video hero, tournament cards, donut income ring and a yellow ticket card with a cartoon warrior
whatItIs: A yellow-green backdrop with a rounded navy dashboard where a notch in the top bar holds the active Games icon, a large video card with a lime play button beside a list of upcoming games with genre chips, a Trends box with a big blue 56 surrounded by floating game icons, three tall tournament cards with progress bars, a right column with a donut 'Total Income $180' with pink, yellow and blue segments and a lime outlined Analysis button, and a yellow ticket-shaped notification with a Clash of Clans warrior and a blue Game Update button.
whatItMeans: Playful and energetic; lime outlines and a torn ticket card add game-like flair.
techniques: Notch a nav bar around the active icon.
Use lime outlines on dark navy.
Show a donut chart with rounded colour segments.
Break out one card as a ticket with cutouts.

vocabulary.definition: A nav bar with a cut-out around the active item.
A card with semicircle notches like a ticket.
A capsule with a coloured border.
App icons scattered around a number.
